changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Seed complete standalone privilege sets for all base roles (idempotent per-row)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_privilege (system_role_id, privilege_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM clinlims.system_role r, clinlims.system_privilege p WHERE r.name = 'User Account Administrator' AND p.name = 'user:manage' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege srp WHERE srp.system_role_id = r.id AND srp.privilege_id = p.id);

changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_privilege (system_role_id, privilege_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM clinlims.system_role r, clinlims.system_privilege p WHERE r.name IN ('Results', 'Validation') AND p.name = 'organization:view' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege srp WHERE srp.system_role_id = r.id AND srp.privilege_id = p.id);

changeSet.author: openelis
changeSet.comment: Grant user_role:view to operational base roles (self-scoping lab-unit read)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_role_privilege (system_role_id, privilege_id) SELECT r.id, p.id FROM clinlims.system_role r, clinlims.system_privilege p WHERE r.name IN ('Reception', 'Results', 'Validation', 'Pathologist', 'Cytopathologist', 'Reports', 'EQA Coordinator', 'User Account Administrator', 'Audit Trail', 'Analyser Import') AND p.name = 'user_role:view' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege srp WHERE srp.system_role_id = r.id AND srp.privilege_id = p.id);

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM clinlims.system_role_privilege WHERE privilege_id = (SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_privilege WHERE name = 'user_role:view') AND system_role_id IN ( SELECT id FROM clinlims.system_role WHERE name IN ('Reception', 'Results', 'Validation', 'Pathologist', 'Cytopathologist', 'Reports', 'EQA Coordinator', 'User Account Administrator', 'Audit Trail', 'Analyser Import'));
